construction: X[j,(i,k)]=1 when j=k, W[(i,j),(i,j)]=b_ij*y_i; det(XWX^T)=product_j sum_i b_ij*y_i
intended_bound: O(n^2+n log n) gates for the full coefficient-encoding polynomial, no extraction bound
initial_data: original p_ij=1+a_ij^2 and z markers; auxiliary s; constants 0 and 1 for incidence descriptions; no target coefficient as data
metric: Equally weighted positive exact assertions; failures or infrastructure errors count as failed checks; not proof confidence
rational_input: A_ij=((i+1)*(j+3)-2*j)/(i+2*j+3), zero-based indices, formal z throughout
remaining_obligation: A uniformly polynomial scalar circuit for extracting the squarefree occupation coefficient or its univariate Kronecker image
